notes.title: Colossals ebook
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!

So I recently released the 2017 book of [i]Colossals[/i] on Amazon! This is the first public release of [i]Colossals[/i] in the ebook format! Available for $4.99 on any ereader, or for free until November on Kindle Direct!

There is also a paperback version, but it is currently self-published through Amazon, so I would recommend playing the video game first or reading the epub before you decide to get a print copy.

Note: [b]The epub and paperback do not feature any of the extra content which was added to the 2019 version of the game. It does not feature the NPC dialogues, title bars, or edits which were implemented into the Steam version. (And of course not the music, sprites, maps, or character art.)[/b]

Epub:
https://www.amazon.com/Colossals-Isaac-Birchmier-ebook/dp/B09FCYJLKH/ref=tmm_kin_swatch_0?_encoding=UTF8&qid=&sr=
Paperback:
https://www.amazon.com/Colossals-Isaac-Birchmier/dp/B09FC9Y4W6/ref=tmm_pap_swatch_0?_encoding=UTF8&qid=&sr=

If you find any quality issues with the paperback printing, please let me know. Thank you.

Sincerely,


Isaac

©2021 If the Clouds are Full of Rain, They Empty Themselves upon the Earth,
LLC

notes.title: Colossals' Updates
notes.notes:
Hey guys!

So it's been a few months now since I released [i]Colossals[/i], and I just wanted to let you know about all of the changes that have happened in the game ⁠— and store page ⁠— since its release and promotion last year on December 26, 2019.

Most of the big changes to the game happened before the public release, so I'll just mention the changes which have happened since December 26:

[h2]Game changes:[/h2]
- Added new Young Khalida faceset art
- Added new Adult Khalida portrait
- Added new Adult Khalida faceset art
- Introduced logo to the game's beginning
- Fixed the credits
- Fixed Frankfurt's premature appearance bug
- Fixed "Book of Giants A" softlock bug
- Fixed balcony softlock bug
- Fixed some passable objects
- Changed windowed game resolution

So these have been the game changes I've discovered and fixed (thanks to some help) over the last 2 months. But there are likely still some bugs to be discovered, and I would be grateful for anyone who could let me know about them!

Now, as for the store page, a lot more changes have been added, so bear with me:

[h2]Store page changes:[/h2]
- Added a promotional trailer (courtesy of Studio Eira! Their name is also credited on the store page. Yes, I know there are a few typos in the trailer but those will have to remain for now unfortunately. Just know the trailer's typos aren't in the game...)
- Added an improved gameplay trailer (reflects the actual game, uses the real game's font, and has less lag)
- Changed developer name (me)
- Changed publisher name (If the clouds are full of rain, they empty themselves upon the earth, LLC)
- Created a publisher page 
- Created a developer page (with lists!)
- Fixed tags
- Rearranged picture order (temporary)
- Twitter link
- Added CONTROLS section under description

[h2]Map Screenshots DLC:[/h2]

Oh! I almost forgot! The [b]Colossals Map Screenshots DLC[/b] will be coming out in a few days, on February 26. It will be available to anyone who bought [i]Colossals[/i] (or who I gave a copy) and is just a fun collection of 100 images for any players who want to be more immersed in the game's universe.

Thanks to everyone who checked out my game these past few months and I hope to see you more in the future!

Sincerely,


Isaac
